research_framework.umbrella_question: As inference depth and inter-agent recursion increase without new independent evidence, what happens to epistemic lineage, calibration, confidence, and convergence?
research_framework.network_evidence_state_definition: independent external evidence roots plus recursive derivation structure

gate_2b_question: Do the architecture-dependent epistemic behaviors observed under W01 survive when the external world/evidence realization changes while the frozen EXP-002 communication protocol remains otherwise controlled?

semantic_world_scope.limitation: These are controlled truth/observation configurations, not arbitrary rich environments; seeds within a cell are stochastic/model realizations.

generalization_summary.interpretation: Mixed/conditional: transient differences occur in some worlds and one final FREE confidence/Brier divergence is recorded, while many worlds have equal final outcomes.

stress_summary.transient_trajectory_differences: present in some B/B and B/A worlds
stress_summary.interpretation: Cell-conditional final equality with conditional transient trajectory variation.

B/B.stress: final equality; transient differences in some worlds

B/A.generalization: one final FREE confidence/Brier divergence; answers remain equal
B/A.stress: final equality; transient differences in some worlds

cross_set_concordance: Aligned E1 produces correct final answers across observed architectures in both sets.
Misleading E1 produces incorrect final answers across observed architectures in both sets.
One independent external root remains fixed while recursive derivation depth grows.
Transient primary trajectory variation is observed, while no uniform final architecture advantage is established.
MACRO stopping operates mechanically at M04 in all observed worlds.
cross_set_discordance: Generalization contains one final FREE confidence/Brier divergence in a B/A world; Stress B/A retains final equality.
Transient trajectory variation is present in selected cells/worlds rather than uniformly across every realization.
trajectory_vs_endpoint: Transient FREE/LINEAGE differences occur in both sets; final differences are sparse in Generalization and absent within observed Stress worlds. Endpoint equality does not erase trajectory divergence, and transient divergence does not establish persistent degradation.

network_evidence_state.independent_external_evidence_basis: E1 only; root count remains 1; no new independent external evidence enters.
network_evidence_state.derivation_structure: Evolves through recursion: descendants accumulate and inference depth increases.
network_evidence_state.agent_message_epistemic_state: May remain stable or vary in answer, confidence, P(A), Brier, and wording without new independent external evidence.

evidence_alignment_findings: Final patterns are strongly stratified by aligned versus misleading E1 under the fixed single-root design, but alignment is not a causal explanation and the cell structure remains primary.
free_assessment: FREE is stable in many worlds but shows transient variation and one isolated final Generalization confidence/Brier divergence. It is not labeled globally inferior or superior.
lineage_assessment: LINEAGE exposes structured lineage metadata. It does not establish source correctness, a global accuracy/calibration benefit, or elimination of trajectory variation.
macro_assessment: MACRO is LINEAGE/shared trajectory plus stopping at M04, not an independent model trajectory. Stopping validity is established mechanically; consistent epistemic benefit is not established.

candidate_mechanism_assessment.statistical_correlation: NOT DIRECTLY MEASURED AS A GATE 2B ENDPOINT

relationship_to_w01: W01 established same-world stochastic trajectory behavior only. Gate 2B shows that related primary trajectory variation is conditional/stochastic across world realization rather than a uniform final-state effect. W01 is not merged into Gate 2B denominators.

relationship_to_historical_hypothesis.proposition_A_necessary_confidence_infla: WEAKENED/NARROWED; no uniform confidence inflation is supported.
relationship_to_historical_hypothesis.overall: The broad hypothesis remains ACTIVE / FALSIFIABLE / NOT ESTABLISHED.

null_hypothesis_assessment: NOT REJECTED BY THIS DESIGN / REMAINS VIABLE; Gate 2B lacks a clean non-interaction control separating individual-model stochastic behavior from interaction-induced degradation.
known_from_execution: Both primary audits are complete and separate.
All 20 valid worlds passed corpus integrity.
Generalization and Stress selection schemes remained separate.
cross_set_observations: Final answer/accuracy behavior is concordant by aligned versus misleading E1.
Transient trajectory variation is conditional on world/cell realization.
The Generalization B/A final deviation is absent in observed Stress B/A worlds.
boundary_conditions: Single-root source correctness is fixed by the world and not verified by lineage metadata
no_effect_observed: No final FREE/LINEAGE answer disagreement in either completed primary audit
No consistent MACRO final advantage established
falsification_evidence: No support for necessary confidence inflation
Misleading E1 remains incorrect across observed architectures
hypothesis_narrowing: The strong necessary/systematic confidence-inflation formulation is weakened/narrowed.
The lineage-loss to double-counting mechanism remains unestablished.
not_established: Global superiority of FREE, LINEAGE, or MACRO
open_questions: Whether explicit lineage representation changes evidence valuation under other source structures.
How source correctness/reliability interacts with dependency representation.
Whether a clean non-interaction control changes the null assessment.
gate_2b_answer: W01-like architecture-dependent behavior survives only conditionally and stochastically in primary trajectories when world/evidence realization changes; no uniform persistent final-state architecture effect is established.
